build_etcd_server: build a local standalone etcd server on a random free port for single-node multi-worker launches or testing
create_etcd_server_instance: create an EtcdServer instance with an optional data directory and automatic etcd binary discovery
run_etcd_server_start: run the etcd server start method with configurable timeout and retry count before giving up
test_etcd_server_stop: test the etcd server stop method to terminate the subprocess and clean up the data directory
review_get_client: review the get_client method that returns an etcd client object connected to the running server
